scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Education of Children
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles
Vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use
Assistance is available for up to two children
benefits_summary: One‑time financial aid ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹30,000 depending on the child’s level of education
